Bill.BriefDescription: Limiting the number of bills a legislator may sponsor.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to limiting the number of bills a legislator maysponsor; and adding a new section to chapter 44.04 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 44.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A member of the legislature may not introduce as prime sponsor morethan fifteen bills during a legislative session, excluding committeesubstitute bills.
